title: WebDGS
subtitle: Differentiable Gaussian Splatting, trained in the browser with WebGPU
blurb: A complete 3D Gaussian Splatting training loop that runs client-side on WebGPU: tiled forward and backward rasterization, Adam updates, FastGS-style densify and prune, and a deterministic GPU radix sort, with the scene rendered live while it trains.

media.caption: Free-camera fly-through of the Western Pacific 713 locomotive scene after training in WebDGS.
